name: Delaware Aging & Disability Resource Center
description: The Delaware Aging & Disability Resource Center, run statewide by the Division of Services for Aging and Adults with Physical Disabilities: free information, referral and guidance on help at home, meals, caregiving, assistive devices, long-term care and other services for older adults, adults with physical disabilities and caregivers.
next_step: Call and describe what is hard right now. Ask for information and assistance. TDD users can call 302-424-7141. You can also email DelawareADRC@delaware.gov. Military service is not required.
constraints: Many services focus on people age 60 and older and adults with disabilities; eligibility and waitlists vary by program.
Statewide; one number for all three counties.

source_evidence.title: Delaware Division of Services for Aging and Adults with Physical Disabilities: Contact
source_evidence.scope: Delaware Aging & Disability Resource Center, 1-800-223-9074 (TDD only 302-424-7141): the single point of contact for information, referrals and guidance on aging, disability and caregiving services; read in full. The page is undated. The division’s ADRC page says the ADRC serves people across the state, whatever their income or where they live in Delaware (https://dhss.delaware.gov/dsaapd/division-of-services-for-aging-and-adults-with-physical-disabilities/adrc/; search excerpt).

name: Delaware Long-Term Care Ombudsman Program
description: The regional long-term care ombudsman for this county: advocacy for residents of nursing homes, assisted living and residential care facilities.
next_step: Call the regional ombudsman program. Give the facility name and county. For immediate danger, call 911.
constraints: The ombudsman acts with the resident’s permission and is not a licensing or enforcement agency.
Serves residents of nursing facilities, assisted living and board and care homes, and people receiving home and community-based services.

source_evidence.title: Delaware Health and Social Services: Long-Term Care Ombudsman Program
source_evidence.scope: Hotline 1-855-773-1002 for anonymous complaints about a long-term care facility and for complaints about home and community-based service providers; online complaints require your name; read in full. The program is statewide, so every county shows it.
